description: Independent PDFium scale control on untouched A7.4 frozen Word/application PDFs. Intensity weighted x=100..200pt, ±2pt Word rule window, >2% mask. Values are application minus Word endnote/footnote centroids in pt; shared half-point runtime fix absent in these inputs.
conclusion: 12pt residual persists at increasing render density, so source raster placement rather than only comparison render quantization contributes. Shared calibration remains empirical.
